parameters.name: ActionName
parameters.description: The name of the component action.

parameters.name: AssetId
parameters.description:
The ID of the asset that is used to send the email.

> Call the [DescribeComponentAssets](~~DescribeComponentAssets~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: ComponentName
parameters.description: The name of the playbook component.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese

- **en**: English

parameters.name: NodeName
parameters.description: The name of the playbook node.

parameters.name: PlaybookUuid
parameters.description:
The UUID of the playbook.

> Call the [DescribePlaybooks](~~DescribePlaybooks~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: RoleFor
parameters.description: The UID of the member whose data an administrator wants to access.

parameters.name: RoleType
parameters.description:
The view type. Valid values:

- 0: The view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

- 1: The view of all accounts that belong to the enterprise.
